description: This file defines the GatewayConnectChallengeSupport enum containing utility functions for handling nonces and asynchronous timeout operations pertaining to the Gateway connection challenge in the OpenClawKit project.

methods.name: nonce(from payload: [String: OpenClawProtocol.AnyCodable]?) -> String?
methods.description: Extracts and trims the nonce string from the provided payload dictionary.

methods.name: waitForNonce(timeoutSeconds:onTimeout:receiveNonce:) -> String
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a nonce from the receiveNonce callback within a specified timeout, handling timeout via the onTimeout closure.
